column4: 珠 is pearl/bead; Canicita means little marble (toy), drifting from the pearl/bead sense
breaks the -ito/-in tiering used elsewhere: 滴滴 (reduplicated, no 小) should get the -ito tier like 海海->Marcito, 水水->Aguita, not the -in tier

-in suffixed onto the participle plateado is an unnatural formation in Spanish; Platin (from plata, matching the Honguin/Marin/Hielin pattern) reads more naturally while still avoiding the plata=money association of Platita
almeja is vulgar slang for female genitalia in parts of the Caribbean (Cuba, Puerto Rico), same problem as concha; caracolita (little conch/snail shell) is safe and still reads as a seashell
